Through BDMS network and the Vejdusit  Foundation, 
BDMS delivered healthcare services to support 
physical and mental health benefiting over 110,000 
people and contributing THB 40.6 million in community 
support.▪Risk and Crisis Management: 
For 2026, BDMS completed a comprehensive risk 
identification and assessment across key areas . This 
strengthens organizational readiness and enables 
proactive, adaptive responses to evolving challenges.
▪Research, Development, and Intellectual Property
BDMS delivered 66 new R&D projects , bringing the 
cumulative total to 213 projects. Outcome included  195 
intellectual property (IP) registrations filed with the 
Department of Intellectual Property and other relevant 
authorities  - comprising 23 copyrights, 18 patents, and 154 
trademarks.
▪Sustainable Supply Chain Management
Through its Local Supplier Initiative, BDMS enhances 
supply chain resilience by increasing engagement with 
domestic suppliers. This approach reduces reliance on 
imports, strengthens business continuity, streamlines 
operations, lowers transportation costs, and decreases 
associated greenhouse gas emissions.▪BDMS Green Healthcare
In 2025, a total of  38 initiatives across 19 sites delivered 
measurable environmental outcomes:
oEnergy savings: 3,818.67 MWh
oWaste recycled: 243 tons
oWater recycled: 1.32 million cubic meters
oCarbon reduction:  3,225.59 tCO₂e
These results demonstrate BDMS’s strong commitment 
to operational efficiency and sustainable healthcare 
practices.
▪Climate Mitigation - Renewable Energy
As of 2025, BDMS continued advancing its climate 
strategy trough the expansion of renewable energy: 
oSolar installations : Implemented at 45 locations
